fact: Benin's digital minister announced at the AfriLabs gathering in Cotonou (18-20 November 2026) that the J'aime ma langue project is open source, with 1,000 hours of data in Fon, Dendi, Bariba and Yoruba, and developers and researchers invited to build on it.
title: Benin opens up its "J'aime ma langue" AI project, with 1,000 hours of data in Fon, Dendi, Bariba and Yoruba
